title: Medical Superintendent
description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Medical Superintendent to lead our Hospital and upcoming Medical College. The successful candidate will provide strategic clinical leadership, oversee operational efficiency, and ensure the delivery of exceptional patient care across our facilities. If you are a seasoned medical professional with a strong administrative background and a commitment to healthcare excellence, we encourage you to apply. Role: Provide strategic clinical leadership and operational management to ensure high-quality, patient-centered care and efficient hospital operations. Clinical Leadership, Strategic Planning, Operational Management, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Compliance. Qualification : MBBS / equivalent or postgraduate qualification, MHA (desirable), Significant experience in hospital administration.
